profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Founder | iOS · Mobile | ex-Meta, -Google, -ClassDojo
profile.summary:
Mobile engineer, mostly iOS focused. I've worked at some of the biggest and smallest companies in tech. Looking for great teams to connect with.

Alumnus of Gregarious, Facebook, Google, Cape, Tableau, VMware. Founder of Zeebu Mobile, Rove IT .

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
positions.description:
Building the next generation of Tableau Mobile apps for iOS and Android:

Initial software engineer on Vizable, a mobile-first interactive data visualization app for iOS: 
vizable.tableau.com 
appstore.com/vizable

Built the project from a research prototype to a live app, worked on all levels of the project from data engine through to UI.  Objective-C and Swift (plus a few random other languages), while onboarding a full development team.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Swift (Programming Language) · Objective-C · Xcode · iOS Development

positions.title: Architect & Manager, Mobile Development
positions.description: Manage development for several internal and external mobile apps on Android and iOS, develop mobile strategy and roadmap, manage company MAM/MDM solution, define internal mobile architecture standards, evaluate mobile development platforms and management technologies, and evangelize mobility at VMware.

positions.title: Lead Mobile Developer
positions.description:
Lead mobile development efforts for several projects, internal and external, on Android and iOS (iPhone/iPad)
HTML5 / hybrid mobile app development, native app development, Node.js based cloud (MEAP) development on Cloud Foundry
Evaluate mobile related technologies for enterprise use
Enterprise architect for mobility

positions.title: Founder, CTO, Lead Developer
positions.description:
Zeebu specializes in mobile software for young kids.  We launched over a dozen award-winning kids apps with several million downloads on BlackBerry, PlayBook, iPhone and Android.  My role included:
Founded the company!
Designed and developed the first few apps for Zeebu on BlackBerry and iPhone 
Developed a cross-platform game and content description language, allowing Zeebu to quickly develop and deploy new activities, media, etc. to our games
Defined product and business strategy
Built and led the team

positions.title: Consultant, BlackBerry Developer
positions.description: Lead on several BlackBerry projects - architecture, design, development

positions.title: Founder, VP Operations
positions.description:
Rove (formerly Idokorro) is the leading provider of network administration software that allows for unified management of all IT systems from a handheld device or computer. Our exceptional team takes pride in knowing that our award-winning solution is lowering costs, increasing productivity and reducing risk in the IT environments of more than 2,400 organizations worldwide.

Oversaw QA, support & business apps, and worked closely with development, sales and marketing

Rove was acquired by SolarWinds

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Technical lead for PCMobilizr.  Successfully designed, developed and launched BlackBerry client-server remote desktop access application, including J2EE server and online store, and .NET Windows desktop agent, under a tight deadline for a successful launch at the DEMO 08 conference.  Application launched successfully to recognition and acclaim in mainstream press.

positions.title: BlackBerry Developer (Consultant)
positions.description: Lead developer for BlackBerry stock-trading application.  Worked with developers at Vaultus Mobile Technologies and bitHeads.  Application was successfully launched and immediately became an award-winning service.

positions.title: BlackBerry Team Lead / Project Manager
positions.description:
Led development of the BlackBerry mForms/Pronto client to successful initial release.
Project manager for release of Pronto forms on phones 1.0

positions.title: Founder, Lead Developer, Product Manager
positions.description: Founding employee and part of team that grew company to market leadership and profitability.  Co-developed flagship products, Mobile Admin and Mobile SSH (.NET and BlackBerry/J2ME).  Managed Mobile SSH through several major releases.  Dealt with customers daily, extensive travel for both technical conferences and sales/marketing events, performed roles in most other company areas.

positions.description: Co-op.  Software developer on MKS Change Integrity (Java/Swing)

positions.description: Co-op.  Java and C++ client/server development.

positions.description: Co-op.

projects.title: Mobile Admin
projects.description: Mobile Admin is used by thousands of users to troubleshoot and resolve any IT issues from any mobile device. When issues occur, Mobile Admin allows you to respond immediately to determine the cause of the problem and take corrective action without having to get to a computer to access the corporate network.
